consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 1995-02-21 show at Delta Center is one of the stronger performances of the year, particularly highlighting the energy and engagement of the band. The standout song, 'Visions of Johanna,' is frequently praised for its emotional depth and Jerry's passionate delivery, despite some minor vocal miscues.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.4 for 80 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans enjoyed the show and highlighted several strong performances, there were also notable criticisms regarding Jerry's vocal performance and the overall consistency of the second set.
